top_jobs.job: When Monday numbers land, help me see which ads are winning and losing and why, broken into hook, message, proof and offer, so I stop feeding ads that look busy and do not sell and the next brief starts from what we learned
top_jobs.metric: share of spend on ads at or under target cost per purchase, 7 day

top_jobs.job: When the 2 or 3 ads carrying the account start to tire, help me have fresh variants of the proven winners ready to take over, so I do not see costs jump the week they fade
top_jobs.metric: share of new ads launched in 28 days that reach target cost per purchase (hit rate)

top_jobs.job: When cost per new customer climbs and most new ads speak to people who already know us, help me aim more of them at shoppers who have never heard of us, using what rivals and buyers teach us, so I grow with new buyers
top_jobs.metric: share of spend on unaware and problem aware ads, 28 day

top_jobs.job: When we can make 50 new ads a week with AI and editors, help me make the ones that deserve test budget and know what each cost to make, so I do not pay for ads that never pay back
top_jobs.metric: production cost per winning ad, 90 day

top_jobs.job: When I decide which creators to brief again, help me see who drives purchases, not just views, and keep their rights in order, so I put the creator budget into people whose videos sell
top_jobs.metric: cost per purchase on creator and partnership ads vs brand handle ads, 28 day

jobs.job: Load every ad we ran in the last 12 months into one archive with the video or image, copy, dates, spend, purchases and placement, so any past ad can be found in 10 seconds
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then a daily pull

inputs.need: 12 months of Meta ads at ad level with media, copy, spend, purchases and value
TikTok ad history with media, when the brand runs TikTok
a naming rule: product, concept, angle, format, date
a list of ads the founder remembers as big wins or big losses

steps: Pull every ad with its media, copy, headline, landing URL, dates, spend, purchases and value
Keep ad-level rows even when 2 ads share one image; group them under one creative id
Flag dynamic and mixed creatives so their results are not read as one ad
Rename in the archive (not in Meta) to the naming rule: product, concept, angle, format, date
Add filters for product, date, spend band, cost per purchase band and status
Ask the founder to star the 5 ads they remember and check the archive agrees with the numbers
jobs.output: a searchable archive of every ad with media, copy and results, dynamic ads flagged
jobs.next: feeds 09-02 (tag every ad) and 09-03 (Monday verdict)

watch.metric: share of last 12 months of spend covered by archived ads with media

jobs.drives: hit rate of new ads, since briefs start from real past results

jobs.job: Tag every ad in the archive by hook type, angle, pain point, avatar, awareness level, format, length, first frame, proof, offer, CTA and talent, and check 20 tags by hand each week
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each new ad within a day of launch

inputs.need: the archive with media and copy
tag list with a plain definition and 3 examples per tag
avatars and pain points
angles library
a person for 20 minutes a week to check tags

steps: Write the tag list: 13 parts, each with a plain definition and 3 examples from this brand's own ads
Tag the top 100 ads by spend first, then the rest
Read the first 3 seconds of each video and the headline of each static for hook and first frame tags
Pull 20 tags at random each week; the checker marks right or wrong
Fix the definition of any tag wrong 3 times or more and re-tag ads with that tag
Show a coverage table: how many ads and how much spend per tag value
jobs.output: every ad tagged on 13 parts, with a weekly accuracy score and a coverage table
jobs.next: feeds 09-04 (why winners won), 09-08 (variants) and 09-11 (awareness heat map)

watch.metric: tag accuracy on the weekly check of 20

jobs.drives: share of spend on ads at or under target cost per purchase

jobs.job: Mark every live ad scale, watch or cut each Monday, name the part that made it win or lose (hook rate, hold rate, click rate or page), and move ads under 3 times target spend to 'not read yet'
jobs.trigger: every Monday after the ad pull, and any day spend jumps 20 percent

inputs.need: last 7 and 28 days of ad-level spend, impressions, 3 second views, thruplays, clicks, purchases, value
target cost per purchase per product
store orders by landing page and UTM
tags per ad

steps: Compute per ad in code: hook rate (3 second views / impressions), hold rate (thruplays / 3 second views), click rate, page conversion, cost per purchase
Put every ad under 3 times target spend in 'not read yet', not in cut
Mark scale if cost per purchase is under target for 7 days, cut if over 1.5 times target after 3 times target spend, else watch
For each cut, name the weakest link against the account median: hook, hold, click or page
If click rate is fine and page conversion is under half the site rate, send it to 09-05 as a page problem, not a creative one
Hand the list to the media buyer with dollars at stake per ad
jobs.output: a Monday table: every live ad with scale, watch, cut or not read yet, the weak link and the dollars at stake
jobs.next: feeds 11-01 (ad set cut, hold, scale) and 09-05 (postmortem of cuts)

watch.metric: share of spend on ads at or under target cost per purchase

jobs.drives: blended cost per new customer, 28 day

jobs.job: Write why each of the top 5 winners of the last 90 days worked: match its tags to the idea bank, the knowledge cards and library ads with the same tags, name the principle, and write a test that repeats it
jobs.trigger: on the 1st of each month, and when a new ad passes 5 times target spend under target

inputs.need: top 5 ads by spend that held target for 14 days
tags per ad
idea bank filtered to paid social creative and ad copy
knowledge cards on hooks, angles and formats
winner board and loser board

steps: Pick the 5 ads with the most spend that held target cost per purchase for 14 days
Find ideas and cards whose tags match each winner's hook, angle, awareness level and format
Find our own losers with the same tags; if the tag also loses, it is not the reason
Write the principle in one sentence, e.g. 'names the pain in the buyer's words in the first 2 seconds'
Write one test that repeats the principle on a new angle, with a pass line
Flag any claim in the winner we cannot prove, before it is copied into new ads
jobs.output: 5 winner cards: the principle, the proof it is the reason, the repeat test and any claim flag
jobs.next: feeds 09-08 (near and far variants), 09-10 (other formats) and 10-05 (copy batch)

watch.metric: hit rate of ads briefed from a winner card vs ads briefed without one

jobs.drives: cost per new customer

jobs.job: Run a postmortem on every ad that spent over 3 times target without hitting it: who saw it by age, gender and placement, where people dropped, the likely cause, and a fix and relaunch plan or a kill note
jobs.trigger: every Monday, for each ad marked cut in 09-03

inputs.need: ad-level breakdowns by age, gender, placement and region with spend and purchases
landing page sessions, add to cart and orders by ad UTM
scroll depth on the landing page
tags and the winner cards

steps: Lay out the drop chain: impressions, 3 second views, thruplays, clicks, page views, add to cart, purchases
Find the step where this ad falls furthest below the account median
Split spend and purchases by age, gender and placement; mark cells that sold near target
If the page is the break, compare the ad's promise with the page headline and send it to 10-11
Write the cause in one line and pick one fix: new first frame, new hook, new page, or narrow to the good cell
Write a relaunch plan with a spend cap, or a kill note with the tag that failed
jobs.output: a one page postmortem per cut ad with the drop chain, the segment table, the cause and a relaunch or kill note
jobs.next: feeds 09-06 (fail note) and 11-04 (relaunch in the good segment)

watch.metric: share of relaunched ads that reach target cost per purchase

jobs.drives: hit rate of ads and wasted spend per month

jobs.job: Promote each creative test winner to the T0 standard that every new brief starts from, write a fail note for each loser, and set a date to recheck each standard
jobs.trigger: when a creative test is read, and the 1st of each month for rechecks

inputs.need: test results with the winner definition written before launch
winner cards and postmortems
who approves a new standard

steps: For each test, compare the result with the winner definition written before launch
Win: write the rule in one line (e.g. 'open on the problem, not the product') and add it to the T0 list
Loss: write a fail note with what was tried, the spend, the tag and the likely reason
Inconclusive (under 3 times target spend): mark as not tested, never as failed
Set a recheck date 90 days out for each standard; on that date run 1 ad that breaks the rule
Founder signs new standards before they reach the brief template
jobs.output: a T0 list of creative rules with proof and recheck dates, and a fail list nobody repeats
jobs.next: feeds every new brief in 09-08, 09-12 and 09-15

watch.metric: share of new briefs that cite a T0 rule

jobs.drives: hit rate of new ads

jobs.job: Check each ad with over 20 percent of spend every Monday for wear: frequency, hook rate and cost per purchase over 14 days, and label it worn out, starved of budget, or out of new people
jobs.trigger: every Monday, and any day the top ad's cost per purchase rises 15 percent

inputs.need: daily ad-level frequency, reach, impressions, 3 second views, spend and purchases for 28 days
share of reach that is new vs seen before, per ad set
target cost per purchase

steps: List ads with over 20 percent of account spend in the last 7 days
For each, plot hook rate, click rate, frequency and cost per purchase by day for 14 days
Worn out: hook rate down 25 percent from its first 7 days while frequency rises
Starved: hook and click rate steady but spend cut by the platform or a budget change
Out of new people: reach flat, frequency over 3 on cold ad sets, cost rising for every ad in the set
Send worn out ads to 09-09 for new openings; send out of new people to 11-10
jobs.output: a weekly wear list: each big ad labelled worn out, starved or out of new people, with the chart behind it
jobs.next: feeds 09-09 (fresh openings) and 11-10 (funnel stage split)

watch.metric: days between a wear flag and a replacement ad going live

jobs.drives: cost per purchase on the top 3 ads

jobs.job: Make 5 variants of each of last month's top 3 winners, 3 near (new hook, new first frame, new length) and 2 far (new angle, new avatar or new format), all keeping the winning principle, and launch each set as one test
jobs.trigger: on the 1st of each month, and when 09-07 flags a winner

inputs.need: top 3 winners with tags and winner cards
voice rules and allowed claims
real product photos and clips with rights
an editor or designer, in house or freelance

steps: Write the principle each winner followed at the top of its variant sheet
Near 1 to 3: keep the body; change only the hook line, the first frame, or cut to a new length
Far 1 and 2: keep the principle; change the angle, the avatar or the format (static to video, UGC to founder)
Label each variant near or far and name the one thing it changes
Check each against claims and use the real product photo, not a redrawn one
Launch the 5 as one ad set beside the winner, never inside it, with the read spend set to 3 times target
jobs.output: 15 variants a month, each labelled near or far with the one change, launched as 3 tests
jobs.next: feeds 11-15 (test launch) and 09-06 (win or fail note)

watch.metric: hit rate of near vs far variants

jobs.drives: cost per new customer

jobs.job: Put 5 new openings on the body of a worn out winner within a week, each changing one lever (angle, offer, avatar or format) across all 3 hook layers: sound, on-screen text and the first picture
jobs.trigger: when 09-07 labels a winner worn out

inputs.need: the worn out ad and its drop chain
hook types that won and lost for this brand
hook ideas from the idea bank
raw footage or new clips for the first 3 seconds

steps: Cut the old hook off and keep the body from the first second the product appears
Write 10 hooks: 3 new angles, 2 new avatars, 2 new offers, 3 new formats (text on screen, talking head, product demo)
Pick 5 that do not sell in the first line and do not name the product
Build each hook in 3 layers: what is heard, what is read, what is seen
Use new footage in the first frame; a recoloured old frame is not a new hook
Launch the 5 in a new ad set beside the old ad and read at 3 times target spend
jobs.output: 5 new openings on a proven body, live within 7 days of the wear flag
jobs.next: feeds 09-06 (promote the best opening) and 11-15 (test read)

watch.metric: hook rate of new openings vs the worn out ad's first 7 days

jobs.drives: cost per purchase on the refreshed concept

jobs.job: Turn each winning principle into 4 other formats (static, carousel, UGC video and a native article ad), and send the matching block to the landing page and the email team
jobs.trigger: when 09-04 writes a winner card

inputs.need: the winner card with its principle
format specs per placement: sizes, safe zones, text limits
formats already live and their share of spend
brand kit and product photos

steps: List formats the account already runs and their share of spend; pick the 4 with the least
Rewrite the principle for each format: one frame for a static, 5 cards for a carousel, a 30 second script for UGC, 600 words for a native article
Keep the same promise, proof and awareness level in all 4
Send the page block version to 07-landing-pages-cro and the email version to 14-email-messaging
Launch the 4 formats in one ad set and compare cost per purchase by format
jobs.output: 4 new format versions of one proven idea, plus a page block and an email block
jobs.next: feeds 11-15 (launch) and 10-14 (carry the line everywhere)

watch.metric: share of spend on the account's top format

jobs.drives: cost per new customer and risk of one ad carrying the account

jobs.job: Tag every live ad and 3 rivals' active ads by awareness level, and show spend share per level for us next to each rival
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then every Monday after the ad pull

inputs.need: last 90 days of our ads with media, copy, spend and purchases
3 to 5 competitor page ids
rivals' active ads with start dates
awareness rubric with 5 examples per level

steps: Pull our ads and 3 rivals' active ads
Tag each ad with one awareness level (unaware, problem aware, solution aware, product aware, most aware) and one funnel stage, using the rubric
Spot check 20 tags by hand and fix the rubric where it is wrong
Weight our levels by spend; weight rivals' by days live, since their spend is not public
Compute cost per new customer by level for our ads, from store new customer orders
Write the 1 line gap: the level where we spend least and rivals run most
jobs.output: a heat map: 5 awareness levels by 4 brands, share in each cell, cost per new customer by level, and the gap line
jobs.next: feeds 09-12 (brief top of funnel ads) and 11-11 (prospecting budget split)

watch.metric: share of spend on unaware and problem aware ads

jobs.drives: new customers per week, and cost per new customer

jobs.job: Brief 4 top of funnel ads for the thinnest awareness level: pull 10 references at that level from the swipe file, keep 3 principles, and write a one page brief for each ad
jobs.trigger: every other Monday, after 09-11

inputs.need: the gap line from the heat map
swipe file filtered by awareness level
pain points and the words buyers use for the problem
T0 creative rules

steps: Load the brain core page, the claims shelf and the voice shelf before any brief
Filter the swipe file to the gap level and pick 10 ads; note why each stops the scroll
Reduce the 10 to 3 principles in one line each; never copy text, logos, products or faces
Write 4 briefs: avatar, the problem in their words, the hook, the story, the proof, the page it lands on
For unaware and problem aware ads, point the ad to an article or quiz page, not the product page
Judge these ads on cost per new customer over 7 day click, not last click return
jobs.output: 4 one page briefs for top of funnel ads, each tied to a principle and a landing page
jobs.next: feeds 09-15 (AI video stack) and 11-11 (budget for top of funnel)

watch.metric: new customer share of purchases from these ads

jobs.drives: new customers per week

jobs.job: Pull rivals' ads and organic posts every Monday, keep those live 30 days or more as signals, write the base principle of each in one line, and turn the best 3 into our own script, static and video
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: competitor page ids and social handles
rivals' ads with start dates
rivals' top organic posts by views, saved by hand or a cheap tool
our claims and voice

steps: Pull each rival's active ads and last 30 organic posts; sort ads by days live, posts by views
Save the top 10 to the swipe file with a note: what it does and which tag or gap it fills
Write the base principle behind each, e.g. 'shows the old way failing before the product appears'
Pick 3 principles that fit a gap in 09-11 and that we have not tested
Write our own script, one static and one video brief per principle, in our voice with our proof
Check nothing copies their words, logo, product or faces
jobs.output: a weekly note of 10 rival signals with principles, and 3 of our own scripts built from them
jobs.next: feeds 09-15 (AI video stack) and 09-16 (static test first)

watch.metric: hit rate of ads built from rival principles

jobs.drives: new customers per week

jobs.job: Find the 10 moments when buyers hire our product from reviews, tickets and a post-purchase question, and write 2 hooks per moment in their own words
jobs.trigger: once a quarter, and when the team runs out of ideas

inputs.need: all reviews with text and rating
last 6 months of tickets and chats
a post-purchase question: what was going on when you decided to buy
5 customer calls of 20 minutes

steps: Pull every sentence that names a moment: a trip, a new job, a gift, a problem that got worse
Group them into 10 moments and count how many buyers name each
For each moment note what they used before and what nearly stopped them
Write 2 hooks per moment using their exact words, not ours
Mark moments no live ad speaks to and send the top 3 to the brief in 09-12
jobs.output: a moments table: 10 moments with counts, the old way, the doubt, and 20 hooks
jobs.next: feeds 09-12 (briefs), 10-17 (moment copy) and 02-customers-avatars

watch.metric: hook rate of moment hooks vs account median

jobs.drives: new customers per week

jobs.job: Make one AI video stack a week: write the script from a winning principle and the awareness gap, write 3 variations of the hook and angle, cut each to 15, 30 and 30 to 45 seconds, render, and pick one cut per stack to launch
jobs.trigger: every Tuesday, after the Monday read

inputs.need: access to a video tool such as Higgsfield
the winning principle and the awareness gap
real product photos and clips
allowed claims and voice rules
past winning scripts

steps: Write the script: hook, problem, product in use, proof, CTA, with shot notes
Write 3 variations that change the hook and the angle, not just words
Cut each variation to 15, 30 and 30 to 45 seconds, so 9 cuts
Render with the video tool; use the real product clip wherever the product is on screen
Check every cut: product looks like what arrives, no invented claim, captions readable at phone size
Pick one cut per variation by the strongest first 3 seconds, and launch the 3 as one test
jobs.output: a grid of 9 cuts from 1 script, 3 picked and launched as one test
jobs.next: feeds 11-15 (launch and read the stack) and 09-06 (which length wins for this brand)

watch.metric: cost per test and hook rate of AI cuts vs filmed ads

jobs.drives: ads launched per week and hit rate

jobs.job: Test each new angle as 3 cheap statics before booking a video shoot, then write the shoot list only for angles that beat the account's median hook and click rate
jobs.trigger: before any shoot or video job over $1,000 is booked

inputs.need: the new angles with a one line brief each
product photos and brand kit
account median click rate and cost per purchase for statics
shoot budget and date

steps: Make 3 statics per angle: a headline on a product photo, a problem picture, a review quote
Launch each angle as its own ad set with the same budget for 5 days
Keep angles whose click rate and cost per purchase beat the static median
Write the shoot list for kept angles only: 5 openings, product in use, proof shots, each at 9:16
Drop or rework angles that lost, and log them in 09-06
jobs.output: angles proven on statics and a shot list that covers only those angles
jobs.next: feeds the shoot, then 09-08 (variants from the footage)

watch.metric: share of shoot budget spent on angles that passed a static test

jobs.drives: production cost per winning ad

jobs.job: Log what each finished ad cost to make and whether it paid back, by source (agency, creator, AI, in house), and show hit rate and cost per winning ad for each source every month
jobs.trigger: when a creative invoice arrives, and the 1st of each month

inputs.need: creative invoices and retainer fees by month
inputs.from: a Google Sheet kept by the founder

inputs.need: which source made each ad
spend, purchases and gross profit per ad

steps: Tag each ad in the archive with its source and its cost to make
Split retainers across the ads delivered that month
Per source compute in code: ads made, ads that reached target, hit rate, cost per winning ad, gross profit after ad spend
Size next month's ad count: spend divided by spend per winner, divided by hit rate
Write one line per source: keep, cut or change the brief
jobs.output: a monthly source table: cost per ad, hit rate, cost per winning ad, verdict per source, and next month's ad count
jobs.next: feeds the agency review on 11-09 and 23-team-ops

watch.metric: cost per winning ad by source

jobs.drives: creative spend per dollar of gross profit

jobs.job: Rank every creator we paid by purchases per 1,000 views and cost per purchase on their ads, and mark each rebrief, renew or cut
jobs.trigger: on the 1st of each month, and before any creator renewal

inputs.need: creator list with fees, deliverables and handles
ad-level results for ads using each creator's content, including partnership ads
discount code and link sales per creator

steps: Map each ad and code to the creator whose content it uses
Compute in code per creator: views, purchases per 1,000 views, cost per purchase, fee per purchase
Split results by partnership ad (their handle) vs brand handle ad for the same video
Mark rebrief when views are high and purchases low, renew when both are strong, cut when both are weak
Write the one line reason for each verdict
jobs.output: a creator table ranked by purchases, not views, with a verdict and reason per creator
jobs.next: feeds 09-19 (brief the next round) and 11-16 (partnership ads)

watch.metric: cost per purchase on creator content

jobs.drives: creator spend per new customer

jobs.job: Brief the next 5 creators with a concept, not just 'make UGC': the principle, the hook options, the claims they may and may not say, the rights terms, and a partnership ad request
jobs.trigger: each creator round, after 09-18

inputs.need: creator candidates with niche, audience and past results
winning principles and T0 rules
allowed and forbidden claims
rights terms: usage length, paid use, partnership ad access
creator fees

steps: Pick 5 creators: 3 renewals from 09-18 and 2 new ones whose audience matches the best segment
Write one concept per creator: the principle, the moment, 3 hook options, what to show
Add a claims box: 5 lines they may say, 5 they must not
Set rights in writing: 90 day paid use, partnership ad access, the end date
Ask each for raw footage too, so new hooks can be cut later
jobs.output: 5 signed creator briefs with concept, claims box, rights and partnership access
jobs.next: feeds 11-16 (run partnership ads) and 09-20 (rights dates)

watch.metric: share of creator videos that reach target cost per purchase

jobs.drives: hit rate of creator content

jobs.job: List every live ad that uses a creator's face, a customer's content or licensed music with its rights end date, and pause or replace it 14 days before the date
jobs.trigger: every Monday

inputs.need: rights terms and end dates per creator and per music track
live ads with media
UGC library with permission status

steps: Match each live ad's media to a creator, a customer post or a music track
Flag ads with no rights record at all as a risk now
List ads whose rights end in 14 days, with their spend
For each: renew the rights, cut a version without that face or track, or plan the pause
Hand pauses to the media buyer; the agent does not pause ads
jobs.output: a rights calendar of live ads with end dates, and a plan for each ad within 14 days of its end
jobs.next: feeds 11-14 (launch preflight rights check)

watch.metric: live ads past their rights end date

jobs.drives: ads taken down or claimed

new_enablers.name: Ad wear watch
new_enablers.what: Tracks each big ad's hook rate, click rate, frequency, new reach and cost per purchase day by day, and labels it worn out, starved of budget, or out of new people, so a winner is not killed or overfed by mistake.
inputs: daily ad-level Meta and TikTok data
reach and frequency per ad set
powers: when the audience, not the ad, is tired
warning before the top ad fades

new_enablers.name: Creative cost ledger
new_enablers.what: Links each ad to what it cost to make and who made it (agency, creator, AI, in house), then shows hit rate, cost per winning ad and gross profit per source, and sizes next month's ad count from spend and hit rate.
powers: is the agency retainer worth it
which source to buy more from
how many ads next month needs
